decisions.reason: The Hebrew repeats the line; so does the Vietnamese.

decisions.choice: the wording of verse 5 at each level
decisions.reason: The repeated call keeps verse 5's Portuguese word for word at each level, so that the reader hears the repetition.

source.text: עֲל֥וּ הָהָ֛ר וַהֲבֵאתֶ֥ם עֵ֖ץ וּבְנ֣וּ הַבָּ֑יִת וְאֶרְצֶה־בּ֥וֹ וְאֶכָּבְדָ֖ה אָמַ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Go up [to] the hill country and bring wood and build the house, that I may take pleasure in it and be glorified, says Yahweh.

en.L: Go up [to] the hills and bring wood and build the house; and I will be pleased with it and will be glorified, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: Go up into the hills, bring down timber, and build the house. Then I will be pleased with it and will be honored, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: Go up into the hills and bring down wood. Build the temple. Then I will be pleased with it, and I will be honored there, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

fr.L: Montez [à] la montagne et apportez du bois et bâtissez la maison ; et j’y prendrai plaisir et je serai glorifié, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Montez dans les collines, rapportez du bois et bâtissez la maison. Alors j’y prendrai plaisir et j’y serai honoré, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Montez dans les collines et rapportez du bois. Construisez le temple. Alors j’en serai content, et j’y serai honoré, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

es.L: {{plural_you:Suban|Subid}} [a] los montes, {{plural_you:traigan|traed}} madera y {{plural_you:edifiquen|edificad}} la casa; y me complaceré en ella y seré glorificado, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.B: {{plural_you:Suban|Subid}} a los montes, {{plural_you:bajen|bajad}} madera y {{plural_you:construyan|construid}} la casa. Entonces me complaceré en ella y seré honrado, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.R: {{plural_you:Suban|Subid}} a los montes y {{plural_you:bajen|bajad}} madera. {{plural_you:Construyan|Construid}} el templo. Entonces me agradará, y allí seré honrado, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Pandeni [mpaka] milimani, mlete miti, mkaijenge nyumba; {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitapendezwa nayo na nitatukuzwa, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Pandeni milimani, mlete mbao, mkaijenge nyumba. Ndipo nitapendezwa nayo na nitaheshimiwa, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Pandeni milimani mlete mbao. Lijengeni hekalu. Ndipo nitapendezwa nalo, {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitaheshimiwa humo, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Hãy lên núi đồi, đem gỗ về và xây nhà; {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ hài lòng về nó và sẽ được tôn vinh, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán.
vi.B: Hãy lên núi, đem gỗ xuống và xây nhà. Bấy giờ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ hài lòng về nhà ấy và sẽ được tôn kính, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán.
vi.R: Hãy lên đồi núi và đem gỗ xuống. Hãy xây đền thờ. Bấy giờ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ hài lòng về đền thờ ấy, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ được tôn kính tại đó, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán.

ko.L: 산에 올라가 나무를 가져와서 이 집을 지어라. 그러면 내가 그것을 기뻐하고 영광을 받을 것이다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.
ko.B: 산으로 올라가서 목재를 가져다가 이 집을 지어라. 그러면 내가 그 집을 기뻐하고, 영광을 받을 것이다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.
ko.R: 산으로 올라가서 나무를 베어 오너라. 그리고 성전을 지어라. 그러면 내가 그 성전을 기뻐하고, 그곳에서 영광을 받을 것이다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.

pt.L: Subam aos montes, e tragam madeira, e construam a casa; e eu me agradarei dela e serei glorificado, diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.
pt.B: Subam aos montes, tragam madeira e construam a casa. Então eu me agradarei dela e serei honrado, diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.
pt.R: Subam aos montes e tragam madeira. Construam o templo. Então eu vou me agradar dele e vou ser honrado ali, diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.

decisions.choice: go up to the hills and bring wood: timber for the rebuilding
decisions.reason: Timber for roofs and beams could be cut in the wooded hills around Judah (Nehemiah 8:15). Cedar for the first rebuilding had been brought from Lebanon (Ezra 3:7). Much of the stone was probably still on the site. |

decisions.choice: take pleasure in it: accept it with favor
decisions.reason: The verb is used of God accepting an offering or a person with favor (Leviticus 1:4; Malachi 1:10). The rebuilt house will be acceptable to him. |

decisions.choice: be glorified: be honored, have my glory shown there
decisions.reason: The verb is from the same root as "glory" (2:3, 7, 9). The LORD will be honored when his house is rebuilt and his glory dwells in it. The Hebrew is written without its last letter and read with it. Jewish tradition took the missing letter, which stands for the number five, as a sign of five things the second temple would lack that the first had, among them the ark and the fire from heaven. |

decisions.choice: be glorified (L), be honored (B, R); bring down (B, R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "honored", which suits the verb, and "bring down" because the wood comes from the hills to the city. |

decisions.choice: "CHÚA phán" for 'amar YHWH, with no "vậy"
decisions.reason: "vậy" marks ne'um YHWH ("declares") at Literal and Balanced; 'amar ("says") is plain "phán" at every level.

decisions.choice: *'amar YHWH* ("says the LORD") is "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다" at every level; *ne'um YHWH* (1:9, 13) is "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다" (L) and "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the two Hebrew formulas apart; God names himself without -시-.

decisions.choice: spans only on free pronouns and possessives that mean God, mid-sentence ("nami", "naye", "mimi", "kwangu", "wangu", "yake"), never on verb prefixes
alternatives: a span on every pronoun, as in English
decisions.reason: Swahili marks most pronouns for God inside the verb ("nitapendezwa", "nitatukuzwa"), and a verb prefix or object marker cannot take a capital, so the deity_pronoun span stands only on free pronouns and possessives. Haggai therefore has fewer spans in Swahili than in English. Mid-sentence, every free pronoun or possessive that means God takes the span, including "mimi", "nami", "naye", "yeye" and "kwangu", even where the English has none; a word that opens a sentence is written plainly with its capital, and "naye" followed by a noun ("naye BWANA") is a conjunction with no span. This holds for the whole book, as in Ezekiel and the rest of the Twelve.

source.text: פָּנֹ֤ה אֶל־הַרְבֵּה֙ וְהִנֵּ֣ה לִמְעָ֔ט וַהֲבֵאתֶ֥ם הַבַּ֖יִת וְנָפַ֣חְתִּי ב֑וֹ יַ֣עַן מֶ֗ה נְאֻם֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת יַ֗עַן בֵּיתִי֙ אֲשֶׁר־ה֣וּא חָרֵ֔ב וְאַתֶּ֥ם רָצִ֖ים אִ֥ישׁ לְבֵיתֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: You looked for much, and look, [it came] to little; and you brought [it] home, and I blew on it. Because of what? declaration of Yahweh of hosts. Because of my house, which [lies] desolate, while you [are] running, each to his own house.

en.L: You looked for much, and see, [it came] to little; and you brought [it] home, and I blew on it. Why? declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts. Because of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} house, which lies desolate, while you run, each to {{gender:their|his}} own house.
en.B: You expected much, but it came to little; whatever you brought home, I blew it away. Why? declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies. Because {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} house lies in ruins while each of you hurries off to {{gender:your|his}} own house.
en.R: You hoped for big harvests, but you got very little. And what you did bring home, I blew away like dust. Why? says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies. Because {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} temple is still in ruins, while all of you are busy with your own houses.

fr.L: Vous comptiez sur beaucoup, et voici, [ce fut] peu ; et vous l’avez rapporté à la maison, et j’ai soufflé dessus. Pourquoi ? déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées. À cause de {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} maison, qui est dévastée, tandis que vous courez, chacun à sa propre maison.
fr.B: Vous attendiez beaucoup, mais cela s’est réduit à peu ; ce que vous rapportiez à la maison, je l’ai dispersé d’un souffle. Pourquoi ? déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées. Parce que {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} maison est en ruines, tandis que chacun de vous s’empresse pour sa propre maison.
fr.R: Vous espériez de grosses récoltes, mais vous avez eu très peu. Et ce que vous avez rapporté chez vous, je l’ai dispersé comme de la poussière. Pourquoi ? dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées. Parce que {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} temple est toujours en ruines, pendant que vous êtes tous occupés par vos propres maisons.

es.L: {{plural_you:Esperaban|Esperabais}} mucho, y he aquí, [resultó] poco; y lo {{plural_you:llevaron|llevasteis}} a casa, y yo soplé sobre ello. ¿Por qué?, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos. Por causa de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} casa, que está desolada, mientras {{plural_you:ustedes corren|vosotros corréis}} cada uno a su propia casa.
es.B: {{plural_you:Esperaban|Esperabais}} mucho, pero resultó poco; y lo que {{plural_you:llevaron|llevasteis}} a casa, yo lo dispersé de un soplo. ¿Por qué?, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos. Porque {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} casa está en ruinas, mientras cada uno de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} se apresura a ocuparse de su propia casa.
es.R: {{plural_you:Esperaban|Esperabais}} grandes cosechas, pero {{plural_you:recogieron|recogisteis}} muy poco. Y lo que {{plural_you:llevaron|llevasteis}} a casa, yo lo hice volar como polvo. ¿Por qué?, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos. Porque {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} templo sigue en ruinas, mientras todos {{plural_you:ustedes están ocupados|vosotros estáis ocupados}} con {{plural_you:sus propias casas|vuestras propias casas}}.

sw.L: Mlitazamia mengi, na tazama, [yakawa] kidogo; na mlipoyaleta nyumbani, niliyapuliza. Kwa nini? asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi. Kwa sababu ya nyumba {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} iliyo ukiwa, huku ninyi mnakimbia, kila mmoja kwa nyumba yake mwenyewe.
sw.B: Mlitarajia mengi, lakini yakawa kidogo; chochote mlicholeta nyumbani, nilikipeperusha. Kwa nini? asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi. Kwa sababu nyumba {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} imebaki magofu, huku kila mmoja wenu akihangaikia nyumba yake mwenyewe.
sw.R: Mlitumaini kupata mavuno makubwa, lakini mlipata kidogo sana. Na kile mlicholeta nyumbani, nilikipeperusha kama vumbi. Kwa nini? anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi. Kwa sababu hekalu {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}} bado ni magofu, huku ninyi nyote mkishughulika na nyumba zenu wenyewe.

vi.L: Các ngươi trông mong nhiều, mà kìa, [lại được] ít; các ngươi đem [nó] về nhà, thì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} thổi bay nó đi. Vì sao? {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán vậy. Vì nhà {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} vẫn còn hoang tàn, trong khi các ngươi ai nấy chạy lo nhà riêng của mình.
vi.B: Các ngươi mong được nhiều mà lại được ít; những gì các ngươi đem về nhà, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã thổi bay đi. Vì sao? {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán vậy. Vì nhà {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} còn đổ nát trong khi mỗi người các ngươi lo chạy về nhà riêng mình.
vi.R: Các ngươi mong được mùa lớn, nhưng chỉ thu được rất ít. Những gì các ngươi đem về nhà, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã thổi bay đi như bụi. Vì sao? {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán. Vì đền thờ của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} vẫn còn đổ nát, trong khi tất cả các ngươi đều bận rộn với nhà riêng của mình.

ko.L: 너희가 많은 것을 바랐으나, 보라, 적게 [되었다]. 너희가 [그것을] 집으로 가져왔으나, 내가 그것을 불어 버렸다. 무엇 때문이냐? 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다. 황폐한 내 집 때문이다. 그런데도 너희는 각자 자기 집으로 달려가고 있다.
ko.B: 너희는 많이 거두기를 바랐지만 적게 거두었다. 너희가 집으로 거두어들인 것도 내가 불어 날려 버렸다. 왜 그랬느냐? 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. 내 집은 폐허로 버려져 있는데, 너희는 저마다 자기 집 일에만 바쁘기 때문이다.
ko.R: 너희는 많이 거두기를 바랐지만 아주 조금밖에 얻지 못했다. 집으로 가져온 것마저 내가 먼지처럼 불어 날려 버렸다. 왜 그랬느냐? 하늘의 군대를 거느린 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. 내 성전은 아직도 무너진 채로 있는데, 너희는 모두 자기 집 일에만 바쁘기 때문이다.

pt.L: Vocês esperavam muito, e eis que [veio] pouco; e vocês [o] trouxeram para casa, e eu soprei sobre ele. Por quê? declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos. Por causa da {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} casa, que está desolada, enquanto vocês correm, cada um para a sua própria casa.
pt.B: Vocês esperavam muito, mas veio pouco; e o que vocês trouxeram para casa eu dispersei com um sopro. Por quê? declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos. Porque a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} casa está em ruínas, enquanto cada um de vocês se apressa a cuidar da própria casa.
pt.R: Vocês esperavam grandes colheitas, mas tiveram muito pouco. E o que vocês levaram para casa eu soprei para longe, como poeira. Por quê? diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos. Porque o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} templo continua em ruínas, enquanto todos vocês estão ocupados com as suas próprias casas.

decisions.choice: I blew on it: I blew it away like chaff
alternatives: I blew on it to curse it
decisions.reason: What little they brought home did not last; the LORD blew it away, as wind blows chaff (Isaiah 40:7, 24). Some take the blowing as a curse breathed on it. |

decisions.choice: running, each to his own house: busy with their own homes
decisions.reason: They are eager and quick about their own houses, while the LORD's house waits. The contrast between "my house" and "his own house" is the point of the verse. |

decisions.choice: Because of what?: the LORD asks the question and answers it
decisions.reason: The question and answer make the cause plain: the poor harvests are the result of neglecting the temple. |

decisions.choice: each to their own house (L), each of you to your own house (B, gender default)
decisions.reason: "Each" means every person in the community, so Literal and Balanced use the gender setting; Readable says "all of you ... your own houses", which already includes everyone. |

decisions.choice: "chacun à sa propre maison" (L), "chacun de vous … pour sa propre maison" (B), no gender span
decisions.reason: Where the English needs {{gender:their|his}} for a pronoun, French "chacun … sa" is already inclusive, so it adds no setting (style guide section 7).

decisions.choice: "cada uno a su propia casa", with no gender span
decisions.reason: Spanish "cada uno ... su" already includes women, so the English gender span has no Spanish counterpart.

decisions.choice: "kila mmoja ... yake mwenyewe" with no gender span
decisions.reason: "Kila mmoja" and "yake" cover men and women alike, so the English gender span has no Swahili counterpart, as everywhere in this job.

decisions.choice: "ai nấy" / "mỗi người" with "mình", no gender span
decisions.reason: "mình" covers both men and women, so the English gender span has no Vietnamese counterpart.

decisions.choice: "each to his own house" is "각자 자기 집" (L), "저마다 자기 집" (B), "모두 자기 집" (R), with no gender span
decisions.reason: Korean "자기" covers men and women alike, so the English gender span has no Korean counterpart.

decisions.choice: cada um para a sua própria casa (L); cada um de vocês ... da própria casa (B), with no gender setting
decisions.reason: "Cada um" already means every person, woman or man, and the possessive "sua" agrees with "casa", not with the owner, so Portuguese has no second wording for the English gender span.

source.text: עַל־כֵּ֣ן עֲלֵיכֶ֔ם כָּלְא֥וּ שָמַ֖יִםמִטָּ֑ל וְהָאָ֖רֶץ כָּלְאָ֥ה יְבוּלָֽהּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Therefore, because of you, [the] heavens have withheld from dew, and the earth has withheld its produce.

en.L: Therefore, on your account, the heavens have held back the dew, and the earth has held back its produce.
en.B: That is why, because of you, the sky has kept back its dew and the earth has kept back its crops.
en.R: That is why the sky does not send dew and the ground does not grow crops. It is because of you.

fr.L: C’est pourquoi, à cause de vous, les cieux ont retenu la rosée, et la terre a retenu son produit.
fr.B: Voilà pourquoi, à cause de vous, le ciel a gardé sa rosée et la terre a gardé ses récoltes.
fr.R: Voilà pourquoi le ciel n’envoie plus de rosée et la terre ne fait plus pousser de récoltes. C’est à cause de vous.

es.L: Por tanto, por causa de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, los cielos han retenido el rocío, y la tierra ha retenido su fruto.
es.B: Por eso, por causa de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, el cielo ha retenido su rocío y la tierra ha retenido sus cosechas.
es.R: Por eso el cielo no envía rocío y la tierra no produce cosechas. Es por causa de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.

sw.L: Kwa hiyo, kwa ajili yenu, mbingu zimezuia umande, na nchi imezuia mazao yake.
sw.B: Ndiyo sababu, kwa ajili yenu, anga limezuia umande wake na nchi imezuia mazao yake.
sw.R: Ndiyo sababu anga halitoi umande, na ardhi haioteshi mazao. Ni kwa sababu yenu.

vi.L: Vì vậy, vì cớ các ngươi, trời đã giữ lại sương, và đất đã giữ lại hoa lợi của nó.
vi.B: Chính vì các ngươi mà trời đã ngăn sương lại và đất đã ngăn hoa màu lại.
vi.R: Đó là lý do trời không cho sương xuống và đất không mọc hoa màu. Ấy là vì các ngươi.

ko.L: 그러므로 너희 때문에 하늘이 이슬을 그치고, 땅이 그 소산을 그쳤다.
ko.B: 그래서 너희 때문에 하늘은 이슬을 내리지 않고, 땅은 곡식을 내지 않는다.
ko.R: 그래서 하늘이 이슬을 내리지 않고, 땅에서 곡식이 자라지 않는다. 이것은 너희 때문이다.

pt.L: Por isso, por causa de vocês, os céus retiveram o orvalho, e a terra reteve o seu produto.
pt.B: É por isso que, por causa de vocês, o céu reteve o seu orvalho e a terra reteve as suas colheitas.
pt.R: É por isso que o céu não manda orvalho e o chão não produz colheitas. É por causa de vocês.

decisions.choice: dew: the moisture that keeps crops alive in the dry season
decisions.reason: In the land of Israel no rain falls from late spring to autumn. In those months the heavy night dew waters the crops and vines. Without it the summer harvest of grapes and olives fails (Genesis 27:28; 1 Kings 17:1). |

decisions.choice: the heavens withheld, the earth withheld: the curse of the covenant
decisions.reason: Deuteronomy 28:23-24 and Leviticus 26:19-20 warn that the sky will be like bronze and the ground like iron for a people who turn from the LORD. |

decisions.choice: because of you: the cause is the people's neglect
decisions.reason: The words "on you" are hard to fit into the sentence, and the Greek translation is generally said to lack them. Taken as "because of you" or "on your account", they repeat the point of verse 9.

decisions.choice: held back (L), kept back (B), does not send (R)
decisions.reason: The same verb is used for the heavens and for the earth, and Literal and Balanced use one English verb for both. |

source.text: וָאֶקְרָ֨א חֹ֜רֶב עַל־הָאָ֣רֶץ וְעַל־הֶהָרִ֗ים וְעַל־הַדָּגָן֙ וְעַל־הַתִּיר֣וֹשׁ וְעַל־הַיִּצְהָ֔ר וְעַ֛ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר תּוֹצִ֖יא הָאֲדָמָ֑ה וְעַל־הָֽאָדָם֙ וְעַל־הַבְּהֵמָ֔ה וְעַ֖ל כָּל־יְגִ֥יעַ כַּפָּֽיִם׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And I have called for a drought on the land and on the mountains and on the grain and on the new wine and on the fresh oil and on what the ground brings forth and on humankind and on livestock and on all [the] labor of [the] hands.

en.L: And I have called for a drought on the land and on the mountains and on the grain and on the new wine and on the fresh oil, and on what the soil brings forth, and on humankind and on livestock, and on all the labor of [their] hands.
en.B: I have called down a drought on the land and the hills, on the grain, the new wine and the olive oil, on everything the soil produces, on people and animals, and on all the work of your hands.
en.R: I have sent a drought on the land and the hills. It has fallen on the grain, the new wine and the olive oil, and on everything else that grows. It has hurt people and animals and ruined all your hard work.

fr.L: Et j’ai appelé la sécheresse sur le pays et sur les montagnes et sur le blé et sur le vin nouveau et sur l’huile fraîche, et sur ce que le sol produit, et sur les humains et sur le bétail, et sur tout le travail des mains.
fr.B: J’ai fait venir la sécheresse sur le pays et sur les collines, sur le blé, le vin nouveau et l’huile d’olive, sur tout ce que produit le sol, sur les humains et sur les bêtes, et sur tout le travail de vos mains.
fr.R: J’ai envoyé la sécheresse sur le pays et sur les collines. Elle a frappé le blé, le vin nouveau et l’huile d’olive, et tout ce qui pousse. Elle a fait souffrir les gens et les animaux et a gâché tout votre dur travail.

es.L: Y he llamado a la sequía sobre la tierra y sobre los montes, y sobre el grano y sobre el vino nuevo y sobre el aceite fresco, y sobre lo que produce el suelo, y sobre los seres humanos y sobre el ganado, y sobre todo el trabajo de [sus] manos.
es.B: He hecho venir una sequía sobre la tierra y los montes, sobre el grano, el vino nuevo y el aceite de oliva, sobre todo lo que produce el suelo, sobre las personas y los animales, y sobre todo el trabajo de {{plural_you:sus manos|vuestras manos}}.
es.R: He enviado una sequía sobre la tierra y los montes. Ha caído sobre el grano, el vino nuevo y el aceite de oliva, y sobre todo lo demás que crece. Ha dañado a las personas y a los animales y ha arruinado todo {{plural_you:su duro trabajo|vuestro duro trabajo}}.

sw.L: Nami nimeuita ukame juu ya nchi, na juu ya milima, na juu ya nafaka, na juu ya divai mpya, na juu ya mafuta mapya, na juu ya kile ardhi inachotoa, na juu ya wanadamu, na juu ya mifugo, na juu ya kazi yote ya mikono [yenu].
sw.B: Nimeleta ukame juu ya nchi na milima, juu ya nafaka, divai mpya na mafuta ya zeituni, juu ya kila kitu ardhi inachotoa, juu ya watu na wanyama, na juu ya kazi yote ya mikono yenu.
sw.R: Nimeleta ukame juu ya nchi na milima. Umeipata nafaka, divai mpya na mafuta ya zeituni, na kila kitu kingine kinachoota. Umewadhuru watu na wanyama na kuharibu kazi yenu yote ngumu.

vi.L: Ta đã gọi hạn hán đến trên đất, trên các núi, trên ngũ cốc, trên rượu mới, trên dầu mới, trên những gì đất sinh ra, trên loài người, trên súc vật, và trên mọi công lao của tay [họ].
vi.B: Ta đã gọi hạn hán giáng xuống trên đất và đồi núi, trên ngũ cốc, rượu mới và dầu ô-liu, trên mọi thứ đất sinh ra, trên người ta và súc vật, và trên mọi công việc tay các ngươi làm.
vi.R: Ta đã sai hạn hán đến trên đất và đồi núi. Hạn hán ấy giáng trên ngũ cốc, rượu mới, dầu ô-liu và mọi thứ khác mọc lên từ đất. Nó làm hại người ta và súc vật, và phá hỏng mọi công khó của các ngươi.

ko.L: 내가 땅과 산들과 곡식과 새 포도주와 햇기름과, 땅이 내는 것과, 사람과 가축과, [그들의] 손으로 수고한 모든 것 위에 가뭄을 불러들였다.
ko.B: 내가 땅과 산에, 곡식과 새 포도주와 올리브기름에, 땅에서 나는 모든 것에, 사람과 짐승에게, 그리고 너희 손으로 수고한 모든 일에 가뭄을 내렸다.
ko.R: 내가 땅과 산에 가뭄이 들게 했다. 곡식과 새 포도주와 올리브기름과, 땅에서 자라는 모든 것이 가뭄을 겪었다. 사람과 짐승도 고통을 당했고, 너희가 애써 한 일이 모두 헛되게 되었다.

pt.L: E chamei a seca sobre a terra, e sobre os montes, e sobre o cereal, e sobre o vinho novo, e sobre o azeite, e sobre o que o solo produz, e sobre a humanidade, e sobre o gado, e sobre todo o trabalho das [suas] mãos.
pt.B: Chamei a seca sobre a terra e sobre os montes, sobre o cereal, o vinho novo e o azeite, sobre tudo o que o solo produz, sobre as pessoas e os animais e sobre todo o trabalho das mãos de vocês.
pt.R: Mandei uma seca sobre a terra e sobre os montes. Ela atingiu o cereal, o vinho novo e o azeite, e tudo o mais que cresce. Ela fez mal às pessoas e aos animais e estragou todo o trabalho duro de vocês.

decisions.choice: drought: dryness, a play on "desolate"
decisions.reason: The word for "drought" (chorev) sounds like the word for the "desolate" house (charev, verses 4 and 9). Because they let the LORD's house lie waste, their land lies dry. |

decisions.choice: the grain, the new wine and the oil: the three main crops of the land
decisions.reason: Grain, new wine and olive oil were the chief harvests of Israel and stand for all its produce (Deuteronomy 7:13; Hosea 2:10; Joel 1:10). |

decisions.choice: the labor of the hands: all their work
decisions.reason: The "labor of the hands" is everything people work at to make a living (Deuteronomy 28:12; Psalm 128:2). |

decisions.choice: the work of your hands (B), your hard work (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "the labor of hands". Literal supplies "[their]"; Balanced and Readable say "your", because the LORD is speaking to the people. |

decisions.choice: "sequía"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew horev (drought) echoes harev (desolate) of verses 4 and 9; Spanish cannot keep the sound, and the meaning decision notes it.

decisions.choice: "hạn hán" for choreb
decisions.reason: The meaning decision notes a play with "desolate" (chareb, verse 4, "hoang tàn"); Vietnamese has no matching pair, so the meaning is kept and the play is left to the meaning decision.

decisions.choice: a seca (every level)
decisions.reason: The sound play of "drought" and the "desolate" house (m1) cannot be kept in Portuguese; "seca" is the plain word, and the meaning note gives the link.

source.text: וַיִּשְׁמַ֣ע זְרֻבָּבֶ֣ל׀בֶּֽן־שַׁלְתִּיאֵ֡ל וִיהוֹשֻׁ֣עַ בֶּן־יְהוֹצָדָק֩ הַכֹּהֵ֨ן הַגָּד֜וֹל וְכֹ֣ל׀שְׁאֵרִ֣ית הָעָ֗ם בְּקוֹל֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיהֶ֔ם וְעַל־דִּבְרֵי֙ חַגַּ֣י הַנָּבִ֔יא כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר שְׁלָח֖וֹ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֑ם וַיִּֽירְא֥וּ הָעָ֖ם מִפְּנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel and Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and all the remnant of the people listened to [the] voice of Yahweh their God and to the words of Haggai the prophet, as Yahweh their God had sent him; and the people feared before Yahweh.

en.L: And Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel and Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and all the remnant of the people listened to the voice of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} their God and to the words of Haggai the prophet, because {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} their God had sent him; and the people feared before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: Then Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel and Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest, with all the rest of the people, did what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} their God said and heeded the words of the prophet Haggai, since {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} their God had sent him. And the people feared {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: Then Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel and Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and all the people who were left obeyed {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} their God. They listened to what the prophet Haggai said, because he had been sent by {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} their God. And the people were filled with awe in the presence of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

fr.L: Et Zorobabel fils de Salathiel et Josué fils de Yehotsadaq, le grand prêtre, et tout le reste du peuple écoutèrent la voix {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} leur Dieu et les paroles d’Aggée le prophète, parce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} leur Dieu l’avait envoyé ; et le peuple fut saisi de crainte devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Alors Zorobabel fils de Salathiel et Josué fils de Yehotsadaq, le grand prêtre, avec tout le reste du peuple, obéirent à ce que disait {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} leur Dieu et aux paroles du prophète Aggée, puisque {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} leur Dieu l’avait envoyé. Et le peuple craignit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Alors Zorobabel fils de Salathiel, Josué fils de Yehotsadaq, le grand prêtre, et tous ceux qui restaient du peuple ont obéi {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} leur Dieu. Ils ont écouté ce que disait le prophète Aggée, parce que c’était {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} leur Dieu qui l’avait envoyé. Et le peuple a été rempli de crainte devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

es.L: Y Zorobabel hijo de Salatiel, y Josué hijo de Josadac, el sumo sacerdote, y todo el remanente del pueblo escucharon la voz {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} su Dios y las palabras del profeta Hageo, porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} su Dios lo había enviado; y el pueblo temió delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.B: Entonces Zorobabel hijo de Salatiel y Josué hijo de Josadac, el sumo sacerdote, junto con todo el resto del pueblo, obedecieron lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} su Dios dijo y atendieron a las palabras del profeta Hageo, ya que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} su Dios lo había enviado. Y el pueblo temió {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.
es.R: Entonces Zorobabel hijo de Salatiel y Josué hijo de Josadac, el sumo sacerdote, y todo el pueblo que había quedado obedecieron {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} su Dios. Escucharon lo que dijo el profeta Hageo, porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} su Dios lo había enviado. Y el pueblo se llenó de reverencia en la presencia {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Na Zerubabeli mwana wa Shealtieli, na Yoshua mwana wa Yehosadaki, kuhani mkuu, na mabaki yote ya watu wakaisikiliza sauti ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wao, na maneno ya Hagai nabii, kwa kuwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wao alikuwa amemtuma; na watu wakaogopa mbele ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Ndipo Zerubabeli mwana wa Shealtieli na Yoshua mwana wa Yehosadaki, kuhani mkuu, pamoja na watu wengine wote, walifanya kile {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wao alichosema, wakayatii maneno ya nabii Hagai, kwa kuwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wao alikuwa amemtuma. Nao watu wakamcha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Ndipo Zerubabeli mwana wa Shealtieli na Yoshua mwana wa Yehosadaki, kuhani mkuu, na watu wote waliobaki walimtii {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wao. Waliyasikiliza maneno ya nabii Hagai, kwa sababu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wao ndiye aliyemtuma. Nao watu wakajaa hofu na heshima mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Xô-rô-ba-bên con trai Sa-la-thi-ên và Giô-suê con trai Giê-hô-xa-đác, thầy tế lễ thượng phẩm, cùng tất cả những người sót lại của dân đã nghe theo tiếng của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của họ và lời của A-ghê, nhà tiên tri, vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của họ đã sai ông; và dân chúng kính sợ trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Bấy giờ Xô-rô-ba-bên con trai Sa-la-thi-ên và Giô-suê con trai Giê-hô-xa-đác, thầy tế lễ thượng phẩm, cùng toàn thể dân còn lại đã vâng theo tiếng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của họ và nghe theo lời nhà tiên tri A-ghê, vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của họ đã sai ông. Và dân chúng kính sợ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Bấy giờ Xô-rô-ba-bên con trai Sa-la-thi-ên, Giô-suê con trai Giê-hô-xa-đác, thầy tế lễ thượng phẩm, và tất cả những người còn sống sót trong dân đều vâng lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của họ. Họ nghe theo lời nhà tiên tri A-ghê, vì chính {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của họ đã sai ông. Và dân chúng đầy lòng kính sợ trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

ko.L: 그러자 스알디엘의 아들 스룹바벨과 여호사닥의 아들 대제사장 여호수아와 백성의 남은 자 모두가 그들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 목소리와 예언자 학개의 말을 들었다. 그들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그를 보내셨기 때문이다. 그리고 백성이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에서 두려워했다.
ko.B: 그러자 스알디엘의 아들 스룹바벨과 여호사닥의 아들 대제사장 여호수아와 나머지 모든 백성이 그들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀에 순종하고 예언자 학개의 말을 따랐다. 그들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그를 보내셨기 때문이다. 백성은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 두려워했다.
ko.R: 그러자 스알디엘의 아들 스룹바벨과 여호사닥의 아들 대제사장 여호수아와 남아 있던 모든 백성이 그들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 순종했다. 그들은 예언자 학개가 하는 말을 들었다. 그들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 학개를 보내셨기 때문이다. 백성은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에서 두려워 떨었다.

pt.L: E Zorobabel, filho de Salatiel, e Josué, filho de Jeozadaque, o sumo sacerdote, e todo o remanescente do povo ouviram a voz {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, o Deus deles, e as palavras de Ageu, o profeta, porque {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus deles, o tinha enviado; e o povo temeu diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.B: Então Zorobabel, filho de Salatiel, e Josué, filho de Jeozadaque, o sumo sacerdote, com todo o restante do povo, fizeram o que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus deles, mandou e deram atenção às palavras do profeta Ageu, pois {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus deles, o tinha enviado. E o povo temeu {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.
pt.R: Então Zorobabel, filho de Salatiel, e Josué, filho de Jeozadaque, o sumo sacerdote, e todas as pessoas que restavam obedeceram {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, o Deus deles. Escutaram o que o profeta Ageu disse, porque ele tinha sido enviado {{divine_name:pelo SENHOR|por Javé}}, o Deus deles. E o povo ficou cheio de temor diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.

decisions.choice: all the remnant of the people: the whole community that had returned
decisions.reason: "Remnant" here means the people who had come back from exile and were living in Judah, the survivors of the nation (Ezra 9:8, 13; Zechariah 8:6). |

decisions.choice: the people feared before the LORD: they were filled with reverent awe
decisions.reason: Fear of the LORD is the awe that leads to obedience (Deuteronomy 10:12). Here the people take the word seriously; verse 13 answers their fear with comfort. |

decisions.choice: as the LORD their God had sent him: because Haggai was truly sent
decisions.reason: They obeyed the prophet's words because they recognized that he spoke for the LORD. |

decisions.choice: Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel and Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest
decisions.reason: The names keep the wording of verse 1; here the Hebrew does not give Zerubbabel's title. Literal keeps "listened to the voice", the Hebrew idiom; Balanced says "did what the LORD their God said" and Readable "obeyed". |

decisions.choice: "el remanente del pueblo" (L); "el resto del pueblo" (B); "el pueblo que había quedado" (R)
decisions.reason: Here the remnant is the community back from exile; B and R say it plainly, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "mabaki yote ya watu" (L); "watu wengine wote" (B); "watu wote waliobaki" (R)
decisions.reason: The remnant as the term sheet sets it at L ("mabaki") and R ("watu waliobaki"); at B the English has "all the rest of the people", the whole returned community, which Swahili follows.

decisions.choice: "những người sót lại của dân" (L) / "dân còn lại" (B) / "những người còn sống sót trong dân" (R)
decisions.reason: The terms note's remnant wording, with Balanced kept short in the narrative; the meaning decision says it is the whole returned community.

decisions.choice: todo o remanescente do povo (L); todo o restante do povo (B); todas as pessoas que restavam (R)
decisions.reason: The returned community (m1) is "o remanescente" at Literal, the prophets' word; Balanced says "o restante do povo", as Ezra 3:8 does in Portuguese, where the English Balanced says "the rest of the people". The same holds in 1:14 and 2:2.

source.text: וַ֠יֹּאמֶר חַגַּ֞י מַלְאַ֧ךְ יְהוָ֛ה בְּמַלְאֲכ֥וּת יְהוָ֖ה לָעָ֣ם לֵאמֹ֑ר אֲנִ֥י אִתְּכֶ֖ם נְאֻם־יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And Haggai, [the] messenger of Yahweh, spoke with [the] message of Yahweh to the people, saying: I [am] with you, declaration of Yahweh.

en.L: And Haggai, the messenger of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, spoke with the message of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} to the people, saying, "I am with you, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}."
en.B: Then Haggai, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s messenger, gave the people {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s message: "I am with you, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}."
en.R: Then Haggai, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s messenger, gave the people this message from {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: "I am with you, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}."

fr.L: Et Aggée, le messager {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, parla avec le message {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} au peuple, disant : « Je suis avec vous, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. »
fr.B: Alors Aggée, le messager {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, transmit au peuple le message {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} : « Je suis avec vous, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. »
fr.R: Alors Aggée, le messager {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, a transmis au peuple ce message {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} : « Je suis avec vous, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. »

es.L: Y Hageo, el mensajero {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, habló con el mensaje {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} al pueblo, diciendo: «Yo estoy con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}».
es.B: Entonces Hageo, el mensajero {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, le dio al pueblo el mensaje {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}: «Yo estoy con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}».
es.R: Entonces Hageo, el mensajero {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, le dio al pueblo este mensaje {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}: «Yo estoy con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}».

sw.L: Na Hagai, mjumbe wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, akasema na watu kwa ujumbe wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kusema, "Mimi niko pamoja nanyi, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}."
sw.B: Ndipo Hagai, mjumbe wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, akawapa watu ujumbe wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}: "Mimi niko pamoja nanyi, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}."
sw.R: Ndipo Hagai, mjumbe wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, akawapa watu ujumbe huu kutoka kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}: "Mimi niko pamoja nanyi, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}."

vi.L: Và A-ghê, sứ giả của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, đã nói sứ điệp của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cho dân chúng rằng: "Ta ở cùng các ngươi, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy."
vi.B: Bấy giờ A-ghê, sứ giả của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, truyền sứ điệp của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cho dân chúng: "Ta ở cùng các ngươi, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy."
vi.R: Bấy giờ A-ghê, sứ giả của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, truyền cho dân chúng sứ điệp này từ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}: "Ta ở cùng các ngươi, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán."

ko.L: 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 사자 학개가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 맡기신 말을 가지고 백성에게 말했다. "내가 너희와 함께 있다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다."
ko.B: 그러자 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 사자 학개가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀을 백성에게 전했다. "내가 너희와 함께 있다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다."
ko.R: 그러자 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 심부름꾼 학개가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 주신 이 말씀을 백성에게 전했다. "내가 너희와 함께 있다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다."

pt.L: E Ageu, o mensageiro {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, falou com a mensagem {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} ao povo, dizendo: "Eu estou com vocês, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}."
pt.B: Então Ageu, o mensageiro {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, transmitiu ao povo a mensagem {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}: "Eu estou com vocês, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}."
pt.R: Então Ageu, o mensageiro {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, deu ao povo esta mensagem {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}: "Eu estou com vocês, diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}."

decisions.choice: the messenger of the LORD: the prophet as the one who carries the LORD's word
decisions.reason: The word means "messenger" and is also used of angels. Here it is the prophet Haggai, sent with the LORD's message, as priests (Malachi 2:7) and prophets (Isaiah 44:26; 2 Chronicles 36:15-16) are called the LORD's messengers. Malachi's name means "my messenger". |

decisions.choice: I am with you: the LORD's promise of his presence
decisions.reason: God made the same promise to Jacob (Genesis 28:15), to Moses (Exodus 3:12) and to his people in exile (Isaiah 43:2, 5). With it, the people can begin the work. It is repeated in 2:4. |

decisions.choice: the messenger of the LORD (L), the LORD's messenger (B, R), lowercase
decisions.reason: "Messenger" is lowercase at every level, because the messenger is the prophet. The message is quoted in double quotes, as prose quotes speech. |

decisions.choice: "el mensajero del SEÑOR", lowercase
decisions.reason: Haggai is called the LORD's messenger, as a prophet; it is lowercase and kept apart from "el ángel del SEÑOR", though the Hebrew word is the same.

decisions.choice: "mjumbe wa BWANA", lowercase
decisions.reason: Mal'akh here is the prophet as the LORD's messenger, so it is "mjumbe", not "malaika" (angel). "Mimi" opens the quoted speech and is written with its capital, so it takes no span.

decisions.choice: "sứ giả của CHÚA", lowercase, for the prophet
decisions.reason: The meaning decision: the prophet is the one who carries the LORD's word; it is not the angel of the LORD ("thiên sứ của CHÚA"), though the Hebrew word is the same.

decisions.choice: "the messenger of the LORD" is "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 사자" (L, B) and "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 심부름꾼" (R); "the message of the LORD" is "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 맡기신 말" (L) and "말씀" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Here the messenger is the prophet, so "천사" would mislead; "사자" and "심부름꾼" follow the term sheet's words for *mal'akh* in Malachi 3:1. Literal uses a distinct word for *mal'akhut*, which the Hebrew uses only here.

source.text: וַיָּ֣עַר יְהוָ֡ה אֶת־רוּחַ֩ זְרֻבָּבֶ֨ל בֶּן־שַׁלְתִּיאֵ֜ל פַּחַ֣ת יְהוּדָ֗ה וְאֶת־ר֨וּחַ֙ יְהוֹשֻׁ֤עַ בֶּן־יְהוֹצָדָק֙ הַכֹּהֵ֣ן הַגָּד֔וֹל וְֽאֶת־ר֔וּחַ כֹּ֖ל שְׁאֵרִ֣ית הָעָ֑ם וַיָּבֹ֨אוּ֙ וַיַּעֲשׂ֣וּ מְלָאכָ֔ה בְּבֵית־יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת אֱלֹהֵיהֶֽם׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And Yahweh stirred up the spirit of Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and the spirit of Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and the spirit of all the remnant of the people; and they came and did work on [the] house of Yahweh of hosts, their God,

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} stirred up the spirit of Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and the spirit of Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and the spirit of the whole remnant of the people; they came, and they worked in the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts, their God,
en.B: So {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} stirred up the spirit of Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, the spirit of Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and that of everyone else among the people. They came and set to work on the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies, their God,
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} made Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and all the people who were left eager to work. They came and began working on the temple of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies, their God.

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} réveilla l’esprit de Zorobabel fils de Salathiel, gouverneur de Juda, et l’esprit de Josué fils de Yehotsadaq, le grand prêtre, et l’esprit de tout le reste du peuple ; ils vinrent, et ils travaillèrent à la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} des armées, leur Dieu,
fr.B: Ainsi {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} réveilla l’esprit de Zorobabel fils de Salathiel, gouverneur de Juda, l’esprit de Josué fils de Yehotsadaq, le grand prêtre, et celui de tout le reste du peuple. Ils vinrent et se mirent au travail à la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} des armées, leur Dieu,
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a donné à Zorobabel fils de Salathiel, gouverneur de Juda, à Josué fils de Yehotsadaq, le grand prêtre, et à tous ceux qui restaient du peuple l’envie de travailler. Ils sont venus et ont commencé à travailler au temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} des armées, leur Dieu.

es.L: Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} despertó el espíritu de Zorobabel hijo de Salatiel, gobernador de Judá, y el espíritu de Josué hijo de Josadac, el sumo sacerdote, y el espíritu de todo el remanente del pueblo; y vinieron y trabajaron en la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} de los ejércitos, su Dios,
es.B: Así {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} despertó el espíritu de Zorobabel hijo de Salatiel, gobernador de Judá, el espíritu de Josué hijo de Josadac, el sumo sacerdote, y el de todo el resto del pueblo. Vinieron y se pusieron a trabajar en la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos, su Dios,
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} hizo que Zorobabel hijo de Salatiel, gobernador de Judá, y Josué hijo de Josadac, el sumo sacerdote, y todo el pueblo que había quedado tuvieran muchas ganas de trabajar. Vinieron y comenzaron a trabajar en el templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos, su Dios.

sw.L: Na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akaiamsha roho ya Zerubabeli mwana wa Shealtieli, liwali wa Yuda, na roho ya Yoshua mwana wa Yehosadaki, kuhani mkuu, na roho ya mabaki yote ya watu; wakaja, wakafanya kazi katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, Mungu wao,
sw.B: Hivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akaiamsha roho ya Zerubabeli mwana wa Shealtieli, liwali wa Yuda, roho ya Yoshua mwana wa Yehosadaki, kuhani mkuu, na roho za watu wengine wote. Wakaja wakaanza kazi ya nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, Mungu wao,
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliwatia Zerubabeli mwana wa Shealtieli, liwali wa Yuda, na Yoshua mwana wa Yehosadaki, kuhani mkuu, na watu wote waliobaki hamu ya kufanya kazi. Wakaja wakaanza kujenga hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, Mungu wao.

vi.L: Và {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã giục giã tâm linh của Xô-rô-ba-bên con trai Sa-la-thi-ên, tổng đốc Giu-đa, và tâm linh của Giô-suê con trai Giê-hô-xa-đác, thầy tế lễ thượng phẩm, và tâm linh của toàn thể những người sót lại của dân; họ đến và làm công việc trong nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân, Đức Chúa Trời của họ,
vi.B: Vậy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã thúc giục tâm linh của Xô-rô-ba-bên con trai Sa-la-thi-ên, tổng đốc Giu-đa, tâm linh của Giô-suê con trai Giê-hô-xa-đác, thầy tế lễ thượng phẩm, và tâm linh của mọi người còn lại trong dân. Họ đến và bắt tay vào công việc xây nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân, Đức Chúa Trời của họ,

decisions.choice: stirred up the spirit: moved them to act
decisions.reason: To stir up someone's spirit is to rouse their will and courage to do something. The LORD stirred up the spirit of Cyrus to send the exiles home and the spirit of those who went (Ezra 1:1, 5). |

decisions.choice: they came and did work on the house: the rebuilding begins again
decisions.reason: Ezra 5:1-2 tells how Zerubbabel and Jeshua began to build the house of God again, with the prophets Haggai and Zechariah helping them. The temple was finished in the sixth year of Darius, in 515 BC (Ezra 6:15). |

decisions.choice: the names as in verse 1; made ... eager to work (R)
decisions.reason: The names keep the wording of verse 1. Readable says what stirring up the spirit means (m1). Literal and Balanced end with a comma because the date in verse 15 belongs to this sentence. |

decisions.choice: "akaiamsha roho ya" (L, B); "aliwatia ... hamu ya kufanya kazi" (R)
decisions.reason: "Roho" here is the human spirit, lowercase, as the term sheet sets for ruach of a person.

decisions.choice: the sentence runs on into verse 15 with a comma (L, B)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision: the date in 1:15 closes this sentence; Literal and Balanced keep it so, Readable closes 1:14 and gives 1:15 its own sentence, as the English does.

decisions.choice: puseram mãos à obra (B)
decisions.reason: The start of the rebuilding (m2) takes the words Ezra 3:2 and 5:2 use for it at Balanced in Portuguese.

decisions.choice: the twenty-fourth day of the sixth month: late September 520 BC
decisions.reason: The date is about 21 September 520 BC, twenty-three days after Haggai's first message (verse 1). The time may have been needed to gather materials, or the harvest of grapes, figs and olives in that month may have delayed the start. |

decisions.choice: the date closes 1:14
alternatives: the second half of the verse begins 2:1
decisions.reason: The Hebrew text marks a new paragraph here, and some readers join the first half of the verse to 1:14 and the second half ("in the second year of Darius the king") to 2:1, which otherwise has no year. Read as one date, the verse gives the day on which the work on the temple began.

decisions.choice: the Hebrew form of the date at every level
decisions.reason: The date keeps the form set for Haggai, as in verse 1. Literal says "in the sixth" without "month", as the Hebrew does. Literal and Balanced continue the sentence of verse 14; Readable makes the date a sentence of its own. |

decisions.choice: The date that closes 1:14 is its own sentence in Korean ("…이었다"), and Korean gives the year before the month and day
decisions.reason: A Korean date runs from the largest unit to the smallest, and a dangling phrase after 1:14's verb would not read; the content stays in verse 15.
